profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Oracle OCI
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I am currently a software engineer on Oracle health. I work on software tools for healthcare practitioners and patients.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I work on an OCI security platform. We use flink jobs which ingest security posture data from various sources (kafka, object storage, API’s) and process that data to create security problems for users to resolve. I work with Flink, kafka, object storage, relational databases, and Redis to process large amounts of security information.

positions.title: Software engineer - Full Stack (Sales Copilot)
positions.description: I work in full stack development in React and C#. I work with designers and leverage my front end and back end experience to implement new features for Dynamics 365 and SalesForce CRM users with the mission of linking Outlook, Teams and the CRM to make data management easier for sellers.
positions.insights: API Development, User Interface Design and +12 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on improving a backend web service through new feature development, bug analysis and infrastructure management. 

Our work requires complex knowledge and analysis of business logic to contribute to streamlined user experiences.
positions.insights: API Development, Version Control and +5 skills

positions.title: Simulation Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead a redesign of key back-end functionality through collaboration with front end and design team. The redesign of this FORTRAN and C++ legacy code improved speed of development and code complexity.

Prototyped new features for plane simulations as part of an agile team working on product development. 

Built automated testing and data analysis system utilizing bamboo and docker.
positions.insights: Version Control, Version Control Tools and +3 skills

positions.title: Computational Research Assistant
positions.description:
Performed data analysis and visualization on genome data from individual neurons.

 Utilized machine learning, statistical models, and various scripts to find meaning in massive data sets.

 Worked with a cluster computing system through a Unix interface, along with data pipelines to process data for analysis.

honors.title: Eagle Scout Award
honors.description: Served as Senior Patrol Leader, which consists of managing troop meetings, organization, and scheduling.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Jul 2015

projects.title: Student-Grading-System
projects.description: I am working with a team on a new grading website for UVA's data structures class. It is a node-based grading system which pulls data from UVA's  course website to provide a unique grading system, and feedback for assignments. We are utilizing a Vue frontend with semantic.UI, and a django backend.

projects.title: Transporters
projects.description: Transporters is an award winning 2-D physics-based video game which features dynamic level selection, realistic ball, trampoline, and treadmill physics, and fun animations.

publications.title: Neurons with Complex Karyotypes Are Rare in Aged Human Neocortex
